**5B.3 Research Note**

**Verdict:** mixed, leaning negative. Srettha did support some longer-run investment conditions and brought in at least one credible market technocrat, but the dominant economic signal in 2024 was a broad cash-transfer program that raised fiscal-risk concerns, while the government also pressed against central-bank independence.

- [Thailand Systematic Country Diagnostic Update 2024: Shifting Gears - Toward Sustainable Growth and Inclusive Prosperity](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/thailand/publication/thailand-scd2024) | World Bank | March 1, 2024 | The World Bank’s reform agenda centered on human capital, innovation, secondary cities, climate resilience, and stronger fiscal institutions. This is strong positive evidence for a long-term investment and macro-stability frame. | QIDs: 5B.3

- [Mr. Narit Therdsteerasukdi, Secretary General of the Thailand Board of Investment (BOI) accompanied Mr. Srettha Thavisin, Prime Minister and Minister of Finance, on a visit to Australia](https://www.boi.go.th/en/boi_event_detail/?module=activity&topic_id=135122) | Thailand Board of Investment | March 4-6, 2024 | Srettha used the BOI and major-firm outreach to promote investment policy, business facilitation, and productive investment ties. This supports a pro-investment, long-run growth posture. | QIDs: 5B.3, 5B.1, 5B.2

- [Thailand's 2024 investment applications jump 31% to 1.4 trillion baht, BOI says](https://www.boi.go.th/un/boi_event_detail?language=en&module=news&topic_id=135253) | Thailand Board of Investment | 2024 | BOI reported a 31 percent jump in first-quarter investment applications, led by electronics, automotive, digital, and other productive sectors. This is positive evidence that the administration was sustaining investment conditions rather than only chasing short-term consumption. | QIDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Thai ex-executive Pichai named finance minister, faces growth challenge](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thai-exexecutive-pichai-named-finance-minister-faces-growth-challenge-3401984) | Reuters via Investing.com | April 28, 2024 | Reuters described Pichai Chunhavajira as a former SET chair, former Bank of Thailand board member, and Srettha adviser. Naming a person with this background to finance is a positive signal for technocratic competence and macro credibility. | QIDs: 5B.3, 5B.2

- [Thailand’s cabinet approves $13.5 billion digital-wallet handout](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/thailands-cabinet-approves-135-billion-digital-wallet-handout-3390007) | Reuters via Investing.com | April 23, 2024 | Reuters described a 500 billion baht, 10,000-baht cash transfer to 50 million people. That is negative evidence for fiscal responsibility because it was broad, highly visible, and immediately controversial on debt and risk grounds. | QIDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Thailand's flagship $14 billion handout faces delays and criticism](https://www.yahoo.com/news/thailands-flagship-14-billion-handout-072635149.html) | Reuters via Yahoo News | August 1, 2024 | Reuters reported implementation snags and criticism from economists and former central bankers who called the scheme fiscally risky. This strengthens the negative case that the government prioritized a politically salient handout over stable, credible macro management. | QIDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Thailand Economic Monitor July 2024: Unlocking the Growth Potential of Secondary Cities](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/thailand/publication/temjuly2024) | World Bank | July 3, 2024 | The World Bank projected growth but warned public debt and the fiscal deficit would rise as stimulus measures were implemented, and it urged more targeted support and higher tax revenue. This is mixed evidence, but it leans negative on fiscal discipline. | QIDs: 5B.3, 5B.1

- [Thai central bank holds key rate, defies government calls for cuts](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thai-central-bank-holds-key-rate-defies-government-calls-for-cuts-3372713) | Reuters via Investing.com | April 10, 2024 | Reuters reported the Bank of Thailand resisted repeated government calls to lower rates. That is negative evidence for monetary credibility because the government was visibly pressuring an independent central bank. | QIDs: 5B.3, 5B.2

- [Daughter of Thai heavyweight Thaksin calls central bank independence an ‘obstacle’](https://theprint.in/world/daughter-of-thai-heavyweight-thaksin-calls-central-bank-independence-an-obstacle/2068725/) | Reuters via ThePrint | May 3, 2024 | Reuters reported that Srettha had repeatedly pushed rate cuts and that his political camp treated BOT independence as an obstacle. This suggests weak respect for monetary autonomy and short-term growth politics. | QIDs: 5B.3, 5B.2

**Search gap:** I did not find a clean 2024 source showing a coherent medium-term fiscal consolidation plan, tax reform, or an explicit Srettha commitment to preserve central-bank independence. The positive side is mostly investment-promotion and technocratic staffing; the negative side is much more direct on fiscal expansion and pressure on monetary credibility.
